headline: Eversource Energy Q2 Earnings Lag Estimates, Revenues Rise Y/Y
summary: ES' Q2 earnings fall short as rising costs pressured profits, even as revenues grow and 2026 guidance and investment plans hold firm.

headline: Mizuho Maintains Neutral on Eversource Energy, Raises Price Target to $74
summary: Mizuho  analyst Paul Fremont   maintains Eversource Energy (NYSE:ES) with a Neutral and raises the price target from $70 to $74.
